articles.title: SpaceX Launches Crew for NASA on Retiring Dragon Capsule
articles.summary: SpaceX launched a new crew of four astronauts to the International Space Station on Thursday, as questions swirl over the company’s plans for the future of its human spaceflight program.

articles.title: Nvidia-Backed Firmus Eyes $30 Billion Valuation in Australia IPO
articles.summary: Data center operator Firmus Grid Ltd. is seeking a A$43.7 billion ($30.3 billion) valuation in its Australian initial public offering this month, according to terms of the deal seen by Bloomberg.

articles.title: OpenAI and Meta Push Ahead With AI Agents, Testing Public’s Trust
articles.summary: Top artificial intelligence firms are working to convince people to use their tools for more sensitive tasks.

articles.title: Chinese State-Backed Firm Disclosed Nvidia Blackwell Chips Deal
articles.summary: A Chinese financing company owned by several local government entities has funded the purchase of restricted Nvidia Corp. chips, according to documents filed with Beijing regulators, suggesting state support for an illicit trade that Washington worries is fueling China’s AI progress.

articles.title: Anthropic Said to Plan Pre-IPO Investor Day as Listing Nears
articles.summary: Anthropic PBC is set to meet prospective investors on Oct. 14 in preparation for its initial public offering, according to people familiar with the matter, advancing its plan for a potential blockbuster listing even amid scrutiny over AI safety.

articles.title: Google Faces $3.2 Billion Damage Claims on Ad-Tech Monopoly
articles.summary: USA Today Co., Daily Mail General and Trust Plc and a class of large publishers can seek more than $3.2 billion in damages for harm caused by monopolization of advertising technology markets by Alphabet Inc.’s Google, a New York federal judge ruled.

articles.title: Nvidia Faces Questions Over China AI Chip Smuggling Cases
articles.summary: Nvidia’s AI chips keep making their way to China despite US curbs. Officials are asking why the company missed red flags.

articles.title: OpenAI Parts Ways With 3 Workers Over Mishandling Information
articles.summary: OpenAI has parted ways with three employees for violating company policies on how private information should be handled, including for allegedly sharing it with an outside group.

articles.title: Amazon Jet Lacked Wind Data Before Miami Crash, NTSB Says
articles.summary: An air traffic controller didn’t provide an Amazon.com Inc. cargo plane with wind information prior to it crashing at Miami International Airport last month, killing five people on the ground, according to accident investigators.

articles.title: 다이소몰, 토스페이 결제하면 1000원 할인…10월 한 달간 진행
articles.summary: [지디넷코리아]아성다이소가 온라인 쇼핑몰 다이소몰에서 토스페이 결제 고객을 대상으로 할인 행사를 진행한다.아성다이소는 토스와 함께 10월 한 달간 '토스페이 이벤트'를 진행한다고 1일 밝혔다.행사 기간 다이소몰에서 토스페이로 3만원 이상 결제하면 1000원을 즉시 할인받을 수 있다. 하루 한 차례 혜택을 받을 수 있으며 행사 예산이 소진되면 조기 종료될 수 있다.할인은 토스페이에 등록한 계좌나 토스페이머니로 결제할 때 적용된다.다이소몰은 결제 금액에 따른 배송비 혜택도 운영하고 있다. 3만원 이상 구매하면 택배배송을 무료로 제공하며 서울 지역에서 이용할 수 있는 '오늘배송'은 4만원 이상 구매하면 배송비가 면제된다.온라인으로 주문한 상품을 매장에서 찾아가는 '매장픽업'과 여러 상품을 한꺼번에 구매할 수 있는 '대량주문' 서비스도 운영 중이다.아성다이소 관계자는 "다이소몰 이용 고객에게 쇼핑 혜택을 제공하기 위해 이번 행사를 마련했다"며 "앞으로도 다양한 이벤트를 선보일 계획"이라고
